summary: AXIA Energia S.A. filed a Form 6-K announcing B3 approval for its migration to Novo Mercado, involving a mandatory exchange of all Class A1 and B1 preferred shares (and B1 ADSs) into common shares (ON) at a ratio of 1.1 ON per preferred share or ADS. The exchange is effective June 8, 2026, with last trading of preferred shares on June 5, 2026. No board recommendation or advisor is named. The company will sell fractional ON shares via auction and distribute proceeds. Holders of B1 ADSs will have their ADSs automatically exchanged by the depositary, with cash in lieu of fractional ADSs. This is a corporate restructuring and migration, not a special situation.
